name: Honeycomb TPE Ergonomic Keyboard Wrist Rest
description: Selling an ergonomic keyboard wrist rest pad featuring a breathable honeycomb grid structure. Made from high-elasticity TPE soft rubber material that delivers cooling comfort and responsive pressure relief during long typing or gaming sessions. The unique open-lattice layout prevents sweat buildup and makes it incredibly easy to clean—simply rinse under water. It features a non-slip base that stays anchored firmly to your desk setup. In good, clean condition with excellent structural elasticity and no tears or defects.
contact_note: Please message to coordinate local pickup or shipping arrangements.
meta_description: Used generic honeycomb TPE ergonomic keyboard wrist rest in good condition. Black cooling open-lattice pressure relief pad.
name_zh: 通用蜂窝网格 TPE 键盘手托垫
description_zh: 出一款成色良好的通用蜂窝网格人体工学键盘手托。由高弹性 TPE 软胶材质制成，独特的蜂窝镂空结构兼顾强力支撑与清凉透气，长时间打字或游戏不易闷汗。材质防水防汗，可直接用水冲洗，打理极其方便。底部自带防滑吸附面，紧贴桌面不移位。回弹力极佳，无任何破损破裂，整体清洁完好。
